metadata.scope: Full-map visual pass across 16 overlapping atlas tiles. Approximate visible road and track traces; tiny, obscured, or ambiguous strokes may remain untraced. No connections inferred across unprinted gaps.
metadata.connections_note: Corridors describe map geometry, not a complete market-engine graph. Marker offsets do not alter traces. Untraced and non-road schematic links are omitted from this map, not declared absent.
